newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Top N.Korean defector says Pyongyang bent on war.
newsitem.headline: Top N.Korean defector says Pyongyang bent on war.

text.p: The highest ranking North Korean ever to flee his homeland on Thursday repeated his warning that Pyongyang was preparing for war, and described the country as "a living hell".
"The North's war preparation is beyond imagination," Hwang Jang-yop, who arrived in Seoul on April 20, said in a prepared statement released at the start of a news conference.
"North Korean society is swept by a war atmosphere," Hwang said. He added that the leadership had a choice between reform and military adventure.
"It is obvious the North has no intention to reform and open, but is only seeking provocation through war."
Hwang, the architect of North Korea's guiding ideology of self-reliance, or "juche", sought asylum at South Korea's Beijing consulate in February.
He arrived in Seoul after more than two months in China and the Philippines.
